The size of the European Free Mesh Network HAMWAN

What is it?: This is a network of high speed P2P microwave links constructed by the European HAM Radio Operators. The microwave links use the same gear used by the cellular towers to connect among each other. Each link has approx 100MBps bandwidth. Connection of up to 80km distance is possible, although connections of 5-10km are more common.

How do I get on?: You need to be a licensed HAM. The total gear costs about 1000$. You need to install it rather like a satellite dish. It may be possible to set up a node without being a HAM but the details are a bit different.

More Info (PDF): https://www.tapr.org/pdf/DCC2014-TheEuropeanHAMNET-DG8NGN.pdf

Big Technical Talk: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3A6DDrJRcws

Is there anything similar in USA?: Yes! https://hamwan.org/t/Wiki+Home+Page
